title: UN Commission of Inquiry concludes that Israel has committed genocide in Gaza
body:
On 16 September 2025, the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, set up by the UN Human Rights Council, published a report concluding that genocide is occurring in Gaza. Commission chief Navi Pillay, a former South African judge who headed the Rwanda tribunal and served as UN human rights chief, told AFP that genocide was occurring and continuing to occur. The commission does not speak for the United Nations as a whole and is not a legal body.

The commission found that Israeli authorities and forces had committed four of the five genocidal acts listed in the 1948 Genocide Convention since October 2023. It said official statements and the pattern of conduct of Israeli forces indicated intent to destroy Palestinians in Gaza as a group. It concluded that President Isaac Herzog, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former defence minister Yoav Gallant had incited genocide and that Israeli authorities failed to punish incitement. Pillay said responsibility lay with Israeli authorities at the highest levels, and the commission said it had shared thousands of pieces of information with the International Criminal Court prosecutor.

AFP cited the health ministry in Hamas-run Gaza, whose figures the UN considers reliable, as saying Israel's campaign had killed nearly 65,000 people, mostly civilians. AFP's tally of official Israeli figures put the number killed in the Hamas attack of 7 October 2023 at 1,219. Israel categorically rejected the report. Its foreign ministry called it distorted and false and demanded the immediate abolition of the commission. Israeli authorities reject accusations of genocide in general.
